author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
You don't need to turn every chatbot into an agent.

Chatbot is light weight and simple. It is good enough for many use cases.

Why people always want to bolt an agent (Claude Code or Codex) on everything these days?
